notes: Covers the PMAY-G phase approved for FY 2024-25 to 2028-29 at the existing rates; in force until a newer pack replaces it.
Clauses with verified=false rest on a secondary source or an unconfirmed reading and must be checked against the official order before being relied on.
Kannada text was written by the team and is awaiting review by a native speaker (kn_reviewed=false).
Exclusion: PIB lists 'households with monthly income over Rs 15,000'; some reports say 'any member earning over Rs 15,000'. This pack follows the PIB wording until the Awaas+ 2024 order is obtained.

amounts.text_en: Unit assistance of Rs 1,20,000 for house construction in plain areas.
amounts.text_kn: ಬಯಲು ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ₹1,20,000 ಘಟಕ ನೆರವು.

source.title: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 1336, Funds for construction of houses under PMAY-G (answered 11 Feb 2025)
source.quote: the unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas

amounts.text_en: Eligible beneficiaries can take an institutional loan of up to Rs 70,000.
amounts.text_kn: ಅರ್ಹ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಗಳು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಿಂದ ₹70,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Loan up to ₹70,000 is available to eligible beneficiaries

amounts.text_en: That loan carries an interest rate reduced by 3 percentage points; the lender's base rate is not stated.
amounts.text_kn: ಈ ಸಾಲದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ 3 ಶೇಕಡಾ ಅಂಶ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಇದೆ; ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನ ಮೂಲ ದರವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿಲ್ಲ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder

amounts.text_en: Up to Rs 12,000 for building a toilet, through Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin).
amounts.text_kn: ಶೌಚಾಲಯ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ಭಾರತ ಮಿಷನ್ (ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ) ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ₹12,000 ವರೆಗೆ ನೆರವು.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.locator: Section: Convergence with Government Schemes, Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin
source.quote: Beneficiaries receive up to ₹12,000 to construct toilets

amounts.text_en: The house must be at least 25 square metres, including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking.
amounts.text_kn: ಮನೆಯ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ 25 ಚದರ ಮೀಟರ್, ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ಅಡುಗೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಸ್ಥಳ ಸೇರಿ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: A minimum unit (house) size of 25 sq. mt., including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking.

amounts.text_en: 90 person-days of unskilled wage work under MGNREGS for building the house (95 in hilly or difficult areas, as read from '90/95').
amounts.text_kn: ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಲು ನರೇಗಾ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 90 ದಿನಗಳ ಅಕುಶಲ ಕೂಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ (ಗುಡ್ಡಗಾಡು ಅಥವಾ ಕಠಿಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 95).

source.title: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 1336, Funds for construction of houses under PMAY-G (answered 11 Feb 2025)
source.quote: 90/95 man days of unskilled labour wages

stages.note: ILLUSTRATIVE split of cost and instalments per stage. Karnataka's official stage-wise instalment order has not been obtained; secondary sources disagree. Replace from the RGRHCL order before any real use.

eligibility_rules.text_en: The household is houseless, or lives in a kutcha or dilapidated house, in a rural area.
eligibility_rules.text_kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆ ಇಲ್ಲದ, ಅಥವಾ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಅಥವಾ ಶಿಥಿಲ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ.

source.title: District administration (S3WaaS, Government of India): Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural
source.quote: Houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas.

eligibility_rules.text_en: The household is on the Permanent Wait List (SECC 2011) or the Awaas+ list.
eligibility_rules.text_kn: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಹೆಸರು ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಕಾಯುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ (SECC 2011) ಅಥವಾ ಆವಾಸ್+ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಬೇಕು.

source.title: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 1336, Funds for construction of houses under PMAY-G (answered 11 Feb 2025)

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: the household has a Kisan Credit Card with a limit of Rs 50,000 or more.
exclusion_rules.text_kn: ₹50,000 ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಿತಿಯ ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಇರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Households with a Kisan Credit Card having a credit limit of ₹50,000 or above.

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: a member of the household is a government employee.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Government employees or those with non-agricultural enterprises.

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: the household runs a registered non-agricultural enterprise.
exclusion_rules.text_kn: ನೋಂದಾಯಿತ ಕೃಷಿಯೇತರ ಉದ್ಯಮ ನಡೆಸುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Government employees or those with non-agricultural enterprises.

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: household monthly income is over Rs 15,000.
exclusion_rules.text_kn: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ₹15,000 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದ್ದರೆ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Households with monthly income over ₹15,000 or those paying income tax.

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: a member of the household pays income tax.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder
source.quote: Households with monthly income over ₹15,000 or those paying income tax.

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: a member of the household pays professional tax (secondary source; confirm in the official order).
exclusion_rules.text_kn: ವೃತ್ತಿ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ (ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಆದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಬೇಕು).

source.title: Business Today: PMAY-G automatic exclusion norms relaxed (11 Sep 2024), secondary source
source.quote: any member of the family paying income tax/professional tax

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: the household owns more than 2.5 acres of irrigated land.
exclusion_rules.text_kn: 2.5 ಎಕರೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನೀರಾವರಿ ಜಮೀನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ.

source.title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Rural, Building a Better Future for Rural India (19 Nov 2024, PRID 2074713), backgrounder

exclusion_rules.text_en: Excluded: the household owns 5 acres or more of unirrigated land (secondary source; confirm in the official order).
exclusion_rules.text_kn: 5 ಎಕರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನೀರಾವರಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಜಮೀನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅರ್ಹವಲ್ಲ (ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಆದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಬೇಕು).

source.title: Devdiscourse: Union Cabinet expands PMAY-G scheme with revised eligibility criteria (4 Dec 2024), secondary source
source.quote: Owning more than 2.5 acres of irrigated land or 5 acres of unirrigated land.

timelines.text_en: The first instalment must reach the beneficiary's bank account within seven working days of the sanction order.
timelines.text_kn: ಮಂಜೂರಾತಿ ಆದೇಶ ಹೊರಡಿಸಿದ ದಿನದಿಂದ ಏಳು ಕೆಲಸದ ದಿನಗಳೊಳಗೆ ಮೊದಲ ಕಂತು ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಯ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಬರಬೇಕು.

source.title: CAG Report No. 8 of 2025, Performance Audit of PMAY, Chapter III (quoting PMAY-G Framework for Implementation para 5.4.1)
source.locator: Chapter III, para on PMAY-G FFI 5.4.1
source.quote: within a week (seven working days) from the date of issue of sanction order
